jobs.description: Privacy Policy - Pixellot This site uses cookies. Some of them are essentials while other help us improve your experience. Read Our Privacy Policy I Accept Decline March 28, 2022 Privacy Policy All page Let's talk PRIVACY POLICY [Last Amended: March 19, 2024] This privacy policy (“ Privacy Policy ”) describes how Pixellot Ltd. (collectively with its affiliated companies shall be referred to herein as the “ Company ”, “ we ”, “ us ” or “ our ”) collects, uses and discloses certain information, including Personal Data (as defined below) and the choices you can make about such information. This Privacy Policy governs the processing and transfer of Personal Data, directly or indirectly, when using the Company’s AI-automated sports camara, streaming, broadcasting and analytic services, video analysis platform, video editing platform, etc. (“ Services ”), visiting the website https://www.pixellot.tv/ , or other landing pages and the content therein (“ Website “) or when applying for an open position published on the Website (“ Applicant “). Unless otherwise stated herein, customers, prospect, visitors and Applicant shall be separately and collectively referred as “ you ” or “ your “. The Website, hardware (i.e., cameras), software and platforms, shall all collectively be referred as “ Company Properties “. This Privacy Policy is an integral part of the terms and conditions governing any use of the Website, apps or hardware, as well as any agreement executed between us governing the use of the Services or interaction with the Company’s Properties (“ Terms ”), capitalized terms not defined herein shall have the meaning ascribed to them in the Terms. Note you are not required by law to provide us with any Personal Data. Sharing Personal Data with us is entirely voluntary. This Privacy Policy applies to all individuals in applicable territories; however, certain territories require certain disclosures to be provided in a certain way and format, meaning, we do not process the information differently however there might be differences in the disclosures, as follows: Additional Information to California Residents: In the event you are a California resident– please also review our CCPA Privacy Notice to learn more about our privacy practices with respect to the California Consumer Privacy Act. Additional Notice to Colorado, Virginia, Connecticut or Utah Residents: In the event you are a resident of one of these US states – please also review Section 12 below ” Jurisdiction-Specific Notices ” to learn more about our privacy practices and your rights under the privacy and data protection legislation which applies in these states. 1. AMENDMENTS We reserve the right to amend this Privacy Policy from time to time, at our sole discretion. The most recent version of this Privacy Policy will always be posted on the Website and the update date will be reflected in the “Last Amended” heading. We will provide notice to you if these changes are material, and, where required by applicable law, we will obtain your consent. Any amendments to the Privacy Policy will become effective immediately, unless we notify otherwise. We recommend you review this Privacy Policy periodically to ensure that you understand our most updated privacy practices. 2. CONTACT INFORMATION AND DATA CONTROLLER INFORMATION The Company, incorporated under the laws of the state of Israel, is the Controller (as such term is defined under applicable data protection laws including the EU General Data Protection Regulations (“ GDPR ”)) of the Personal Data. For any question, inquiry or concern related to this Privacy Policy or the processing of your Personal Data, you may contact as follows: The Company’s data protection officer (“DPO”): Mr. Eran Gutman, at EranG@Pixellot.tv By email: privacy_pixellot@pixellot.tv By mail : Granit 11 St. Petach-Tikva, Israel. 3. DATA PROCESSED BY THE COMPANY We may collect two types of information from you, depending on your interaction with us. The first type of information is non-identifiable and anonymous information (“ Non-Personal Data ”). We are not aware of the identity of the individual from who we have collected the Non-Personal Data. Non-Personal Data which is being gathered consists of technical information, and may contain, among other things, the type of operating system, type of device, time and date accessed the Service, language preference, screen resolution, or aggregated data and insights which do not personally identify or could identify an individual. The second type of information is individually identifiable information, namely information that identifies an individual or may with reasonable effort identify an individual (“ Personal Data ” or “ Personal Information ” as defined under the applicable data protection law). For the avoidance of doubt, any Non-Personal Data connected or linked to Personal Data shall be deemed as Personal Data as long as such connection or linkage exists. As detailed below, we may also collect or process sensitive Personal Data constituting photograph, or revealing bio-metric data of athletes that may also be children, etc. (“ Special Categories of Personal Data ”). When using our Services, we may collect and process facial recognition information of athletes through our facial recognition software, which allows for specific individuals including Childrens to be detected in photographs and videos. Depending on the applicable laws, some of the information collected by the facial recognition feature may be considered “ biometric data “. Customers will be able to opt-out of such data collection by opting out of the facial recognition feature altogether. Face recognition related-data, including biometric data that we collect from athletes, will only be used to provide Services. The biometric data will be stored securely in our database and will only be retained for as long as required by applicable law. We will not sell, lease, trade or otherwise profit from Personal Dat

jobs.description: Job opportunity: Software Developer This site uses cookies. Some of them are essentials while other help us improve your experience. Read Our Privacy Policy I Accept Decline Software Developer Israel R&D Full-time Senior Apply Now ← All Jobs Software Developer Israel · Full-time · Senior About The Position About The Position Ready to build the technology behind live sports broadcasts seen across the globe? At Pixellot, we're transforming the way sports events are captured, produced, and shared. Our automated solutions power professional and amateur sports organizations worldwide - from the camera on the field all the way to the broadcast. We're looking for a hands-on Software Developer to join our R&D team, working on the full pipeline - cameras, video processing, automated production, graphics, and backend infrastructure. If you love low-level systems, real-time challenges, and seeing your code live in actual sports arenas, this is the role for you. As part of your role, you will: Develop and maintain high-performance C++ systems across the video pipeline Work on real-time video processing, ingest/transcode pipelines, and streaming infrastructure Collaborate with the team on backend services written in Python and Go Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in multithreaded, low-latency systems Work closely with Product, QA, and DevOps to ship reliable, scalable features Leverage AI tools (primarily Claude) as part of your daily development workflow Requirements B.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent or relevant military tech unit experience. 4–5 years of hands-on software development experience. Strong C++ background (C++11 and above). Experience in low-level, system-level development on Linux. Familiarity with multithreading, concurrency, and memory management. Background that spans both hardware and software domains (e.g., embedded, IoT, military tech units). Strong communication skills and ability to work in a collaborative team. Bonus points if you have: Experience with video streaming, real-time video processing, or multimedia frameworks (e.g., FFmpeg, CUDA) Familiarity with streaming protocols (UDP, TCP, RTMP, HLS) or transport-layer development Experience with Go or Python Background in IoT or embedded systems Experience working in Agile environments Hands-on experience using AI coding tools in your workflow Why You'll Love Working Here Be part of a fast-paced, innovative R&D environment Tackle real-time, high-performance technical challenges Help shape the architecture behind the next generation of sports content technology Collaborate with top engineers, product managers, and AI specialists See your work deployed in real-world live sports scenarios across the globe Join the team! ﻿ Join the team! If you're a strong, hands-on engineer excited by low-level systems and real-time video - we'd love to hear from you. jobs.title: Sales Engineer Sales · Senior
jobs.description: Job opportunity: Sales Engineer This site uses cookies. Some of them are essentials while other help us improve your experience. Read Our Privacy Policy I Accept Decline Sales Engineer United States Sales Senior Apply Now ← All Jobs Sales Engineer United States · Senior About The Position About the Position Pixellot is the world leader in automated video and data solutions for youth and amateur sports, with over 25,000 AI-enabled venues worldwide capturing over 2 million hours of content. We're building the platform that keeps every game in play AI cameras, automated production, streaming, analytics, and monetization and we need someone who can own the field when a deal is on the line. We're looking for a hands-on Sales Engineer who can join active sales opportunities and turn customer needs into working technical solutions. You’ll meet with prospects, understand their technical requirements, and build tailored proofs of concept using scripts, integrations, APIs, data connections, or other practical solutions needed to demonstrate the value of our platform. You’ll also work closely with our R&D teams in Europe and Israel, so flexibility to collaborate across time zones is important. Internally, you’ll act as the technical link between Sales, Product, and R&D validating what is technically feasible, helping shape solutions, and making sure we set the right expectations with customers before commitments are made. As part of your role, you will: Drive Pre-Sales Prototyping: Partner with Sales on strategic opportunities to build and present working proofs-of-concept (PoCs). Engineer Creative Solutions: Make rapid build-vs-simulate calls and run workarounds (scripts, temporary API bridges, data feeds) to close product gaps and prove our capabilities live. Translate Tech to Revenue: Present to technical and business stakeholders alike, from CTOs to league leadership, so they see the business case and monetization value, not just a demo. Own the Implementation: Carry the deal across the finish line partner with the customer's technical team to turn your PoC into a live integration and stay accountable through the first stable production release. Champion the North American Market: Be the definitive technical voice of the NA customer to our Israel-based Product and R&D teams, turning field feedback into structured roadmap input. Scale Your Wins: Turn every successful deployment into reusable assets demo environments, reference architectures, playbooks so the next deal closes even faster. Requirements You should bring with you: A Hands-On, Scrappy Builder: You write code regularly (APIs, scripting, basic cloud) and have a track record of making undocumented or unfamiliar third-party systems do what you need. Commercial & Executive Presence: You confidently present live to CTOs and business leaders, handle pushback on the spot, and tie technical architecture directly to revenue. High Autonomy & Good Judgment: You can take an open-ended ask and run with it without a spec, while knowing exactly where the line sits between demonstrating a capability and overstating one. End-to-End Follow-Through: You stay in the game after the contract is signed as motivated by a stable, live integration as by winning the deal. Global Collaboration: Comfortable working across North American time zones while staying tightly aligned with an R&D team based in Israel. Track Record in a Deal-Facing Technical Role: Several years of experience in pre-sales, solutions engineering, or technical account management, ideally in B2B SaaS. Strong Ownership & Communication: You bring clarity to ambiguity and communicate with equal confidence to engineers and non-technical stakeholders. Background in pre-sales, solutions engineering, hackathons, or early-stage startups (0-to-1 building). Bonus points if you have: Experience carrying a signed deal into production at a B2B SaaS company (implementation, professional services, or technical onboarding). Familiarity with sports technology, video/streaming pipelines, or B2B SaaS integration patterns. ﻿ ﻿ Why You'll Love Working Here Make an Impact Where It Matters: Your work reaches millions of sports fans, athletes, families, clubs, and coaches around the world — from parents watching a Friday night game to coaches looking for their next competitive edge. Play with Real Technical Challenges: Build technology around real-time video at global scale, consumer experiences that need to feel effortless, and AI capabilities that are changing how sports are captured, produced, watched, and analyzed. Be Part of a Strong Team: Work alongside experienced R&D, Product, and business leaders, with talented people who care about solving real customer problems and continuously raising the bar. · Location: This is a hybrid position based in the continental United States that requires occasional travel. · Benefits: We offer a full comprehensive package including healthcare, dental, vision, and a 401(k) plan.
